# Agricalc

> Agricalc is a free collection of science-based agriculture calculators covering the full farming cycle - planting, fertilization, irrigation, harvest, and marketing. Built on established agricultural formulas and reference data. No registration required, works offline (PWA), multi-language, mobile-friendly.

This site publishes 140 free calculators, 88 blog articles, 45 in-depth guides, a 53-term agricultural glossary, and an 80-term English/Spanish/French terminology dictionary.

## Site

- Homepage: https://agricalc.online/
- Languages: English (default, /), Spanish (/es/), French (/fr/) - every calculator, article and guide is available in all three languages, e.g. /es/tools/seed-calculator.html
- Offline: installable PWA, all calculators work without a network connection
- Cost: 100% free, no registration, no ads on tool pages
- Sitemap: https://agricalc.online/sitemap_index.xml
- About: https://agricalc.online/about.html
- FAQ: https://agricalc.online/faq.html
- Contact: https://agricalc.online/contact.html
